acceptance_criteria: The task has a precise user-visible or maintainability outcome.
The implementation can be reviewed and verified in isolation.
proposal.impact: The task improves a known workflow, bug, balance issue, or development loop.
proposal.problem: A specific issue discovered by the scout.
proposal.proposed_change: A focused change that should fit in one worker thread.
rejection_conditions: Reject if acceptance criteria are vague.
Reject if likely touched files collide with higher-priority active work.
required_proof: Run the smallest relevant automated test.
Provide screenshots or visual probe artifacts for visual/UI changes.
proposal.risk: The highest-risk behavior or shared file touched.
proposal.why_now: Why this is worth spending an autonomous worker on.
